title: Math Proof Codex
description: Two tracks side by side: theorems proved, and conjectures refuted by checked counterexamples.

conjecture.description: Universally quantified claims with machine-checkable predicates. FALSIFIED means a witness was found and independently verified; VERIFIED_EXHAUSTIVE means the whole declared space was searched without finding one, which proves the claim over that space and nowhere else.

counterexample.description: Concrete witnesses and how each was checked. VERIFIED_EXACT means two independent evaluators agreed; CONTESTED means they disagreed and one of them has a bug; REJECTED means the claim did not survive checking.

claim_contribution.description: Separately attackable contributions. KILLED means the literature already reports it; WOUNDED means it must be narrowed; UNDER_SEARCHED means nothing was found but the search has not earned a clear verdict.

prior_art_threat.description: Prior art aimed at a specific claim. KILLS / WOUNDS / ADJACENT / BACKGROUND, worst verdict wins.

prior_art_pass.description: One sweep of the literature. Two passes must differ in phrasing or engine to count as independent.

prior_art_query.description: The search log. A row with results = 0 is a negative search, and negative searches are the only evidence that can earn a CLEAR verdict.

falsification.description: Obstructions that block a route, with or without an explicit witness.

claim_board.title: Claim board
claim_board.description: Every declared contribution with its prior-art verdict.

blocking_publication.title: Claims that cannot be stated as written
blocking_publication.description: Killed, wounded, or using priority language the search has not earned.
blocking_publication.sql: select slug, status, statement_md, reasons_md from claim_contribution where status in ('KILLED','WOUNDED') or surgery_required = 1 order by updated_at desc

prior_art_threats.title: Prior art to cite and distinguish
prior_art_threats.description: Everything found, including ADJACENT work that costs nothing but must still be cited.

negative_searches.title: Negative search log
negative_searches.description: Queries that returned nothing. A CLEAR verdict with no rows behind it is unsupported.

search_angle_coverage.title: Search angle coverage
search_angle_coverage.description: Which angles were actually searched. Concepts hide under other vocabularies, so a gap here is where the killing citation is hiding.
search_angle_coverage.sql: select coalesce(nullif(q.angle,''),'(untagged)') as angle, count(*) as queries, sum(case when q.results = 0 then 1 else 0 end) as negative from prior_art_query q group by angle order by queries desc

conjecture_board.title: Conjecture board
conjecture_board.description: Every declared conjecture with its verdict and witness counts.

contested_counterexamples.title: Contested counterexamples (investigate first)
contested_counterexamples.description: Assignments the two evaluators disagreed about. A non-empty result is a bug, not a mathematical finding, and blocks any refutation that depends on it.

discarded_claims.title: Discarded witness claims
discarded_claims.description: Proposed counterexamples that failed independent checking, newest first. A strategy that keeps appearing here is proposing witnesses it has not checked.
discarded_claims.sql: select c.created_at, cj.slug as conjecture, c.witness_md, c.source, c.verifier_notes_md, c.rationale_md from counterexample c left join conjecture cj on cj.id = c.conjecture_id where c.verification in ('REJECTED','UNCHECKED') order by c.created_at desc

refutation_yield_by_strategy.title: Refutation yield by strategy
refutation_yield_by_strategy.description: Which lanes actually produce witnesses that survive checking.
refutation_yield_by_strategy.sql: select s.slug as strategy, count(*) as claims, sum(case when c.verification in ('VERIFIED_EXACT','VERIFIED_SINGLE') then 1 else 0 end) as survived, sum(case when c.verification = 'REJECTED' then 1 else 0 end) as discarded from counterexample c join strategy s on s.id = c.strategy_id group by s.slug order by survived desc, claims desc
